note: Self-assessment only. It is not a test and does not give a CEFR level. Statements are written for learners and informed by CEFR Companion Volume (2020) descriptors; see design/cefr-alignment.md for the mapping and the exact descriptor wording.

scale.label: I can do this with a lot of help
I can do this with a little help
I can do this on my own

statements.text: I can buy a train ticket and ask for and understand simple directions.
I can order food and explain a dietary need, like an allergy.
I can describe a common minor health problem at a pharmacy and check the instructions I'm given.
I can explain a problem with a booking and agree on a simple solution.
When I don't understand, I can ask people to repeat, slow down or spell, and I can check that I understood.
